gui.settings.skill_saved:
Saved. This is how you add it to Claude:

1. Open Claude (Chat or Cowork) and go to Customize -> Skills.
2. Click "Upload skill" and choose the zip file.

If you have an older version, delete it first. The new one has all the words the program has learned.

Claude fetches the text, corrects and translates it and sends it back here. You do not need to do anything here.

Follow along in the chat. If Claude stops on the way, write "continue" to Claude.
